basic_info.description: This masterfully refined Edwardian is located in San Francisco's coveted Inner Richmond. Just steps from the Presidio, Golden Gate Park and world-class dining on Clement, this home defines San Francisco living at its finest.   Designed for both grand entertaining and serene living it's flexible floor plan seamlessly blends soaring ceilings, rich hardwood floors, sumptuous natural light and exquisite modern finishes into the perfect urban residence. At its heart the home's grand main level, with a chef inspired kitchen, opens to an enchanting backyard oasis. With lush gardens and a versatile backyard studio it is the perfect space for work, wellness and soires under the stars. Upstairs the primary suite offers a spa bath, a private deck for sunset views, and a connected nursery. This level also features a generous guest bedroom and full bath. The lower level has a media lounge and wet bar, perfect for movie night and a 3rd bedroom with ensuite full bath. With a private entrance it is the perfect set up for a completely separate apartment, ideal for multi generational living or income generation.   With solar panels, a Tesla Powerwall, smart lighting and a fully integrated Atmos Sound System the home's rich tech array is impressive, and combines sustainability with sophistication.
